title: Friendly empty states on the library
objective: Give the library friendly empty states (data-testid="empty"). An empty library reads "Your library is empty. Upload a document to share it." A search with no matches reads 'No documents match "<search>"' with a link to clear the search (data-testid="clear-search", href="/"). The search text is escaped.
acceptance: An empty library reads the upload line
A search with no match names the search and offers a clear-search link
The search text is escaped in the message
